decision.title: Code hash portability decision
decision.rationale: compute_code_hash() enumerates directories in filesystem order, so the same source tree produces different digests on different checkouts; the authorized v1 code_hash must remain 2efd3b18fe3f42f42fbd97cce5825d2cfccc6e463a56c1fb8d25d891ab9c35b2. Do not edit src/breakout_research/ (that changes the hashed set and invalidates v1 authorization). Verification must use an order-independent canonical digest.

digests.canonical_source_digest_description: sha256 of all .py files under src/breakout_research/ in path-sorted order of relative paths (order-independent)
